_about: Default pages of the hotel-casino stub (engine/pages/article.mjs specs). A site overrides them all with its own content/pages.json. {brand}, {company}, {email} and {updated} are filled from site.config.json. Mode A (the default) is a domain with no gaming content at all, so these pages never mention it. Placeholder copy: the copy lane replaces every page before launch.
